changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from sys.objects where object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[ClaimMapping]') and type in (N'U')) begin create table dbo.ClaimMapping ( ID int identity not null, ClientID int not null, CompanyID int not null, DomainSettingID int not null, AuthenticationType int not null, ClaimType int not null, Path nvarchar(250) not null, IsArray bit not null, [Action] int not null, constraint [PK_ClaimMapping] primary key clustered ( [ID] asc ) ) end
